answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 95 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a timber bet on surviving 95 epochs of grading, and every oasis settlement recomputes the juniper schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 6 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
